lines.zh: 我悬空滑行，脚下什么都没有。
lines.en: I glide through the air with nothing under my feet.
My mechanical arms swing and split the wind.
I round a tower without a second glance.

lines.zh: 这具身体的关节发出细响。
lines.en: The joints of this body whisper.
I fly toward that energy signature.

lines.zh: 金属皮肤在阳光下泛灰。
lines.en: My metal skin turns gray in the sun.
I don't land; landing looks undignified.

lines.zh: 两格的高，比原来的那具更窄。
lines.en: Two blocks tall, narrower than the original.
I drop low and skim the ground.

lines.zh: 风里有一点点血的味道。
lines.en: There's a hint of blood on the wind.

lines.zh: 我停下来，校准了一下视野。
lines.en: I stop and calibrate my field of view.
Every step already has its landing point.

lines.zh: 待机中，冷却回路在低鸣。
lines.en: Standing by; my cooling loop hums low.

lines.zh: 我数着这附近的生命体。
lines.en: I count the living things nearby.
Each one is more useless than the last.

lines.zh: 我在等命令，或者等一个对手。
lines.en: I wait for an order, or for a rival.

lines.zh: 我的视线停在那块石头上。
lines.en: My gaze settles on that stone.

lines.zh: 金属不呼吸，也就没有叹息。
lines.en: Metal doesn't breathe, so it can't sigh.

lines.zh: 有只鸟撞在我胸口，掉了下去。
lines.en: A bird hits my chest and drops.
I'm redistributing my energy.

lines.zh: 这地方比我预想的安静。
lines.en: This place is quieter than I expected.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，看着它张开合拢。
lines.en: I extend a hand and watch it open and close.
I'm not bored, only empty.
Self-check: all clear.

lines.zh: 那颗星球还在我记忆里。
lines.en: That planet is still in my memory.

lines.zh: 没有敌人时，我像块废铁。
lines.en: Without an enemy, I'm scrap.

lines.zh: 你的气，比我见过的都薄。
lines.en: Your energy is thinner than any I've seen.
I've scanned you: three weak points.
Lift your face; let me see it clearly.
You mean to beat me with your fists?

lines.zh: 你的脉搏比刚才快了一些。
lines.en: Your pulse quickened a little.

lines.zh: 我到这边来，不是来聊天的。
lines.en: I didn't come here to talk.

lines.zh: 你站姿不错，可惜用错了地方。
lines.en: Your stance is good — wasted here.

lines.zh: 我可以给你一个转身的机会。
lines.en: I can offer you one chance to turn away.
The energy on you is trembling.
I can see you without eyes.
At this height I look down on you exactly.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的记录也跟着动。
lines.en: You moved, and my record moved with you.

lines.zh: 我不想听理由，只想看招式。
lines.en: I don't want reasons, only techniques.
Don't turn your back; that's a waste.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你最好准备好。
lines.en: I'll count to three; be ready.

lines.zh: 你的影子贴在我脚边不敢动。
lines.en: Your shadow clings to my feet, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 我笑不出来，这具脸做不了。
lines.en: I can't smile; this face won't do it.

lines.zh: 金属盯着人，比活人更久。
lines.en: Metal stares longer than the living do.
Armor hit; I'm recalculating.
This damage still leaves me able to laugh.
A few metal shards fall away.
My circuits scramble and I steady them.
You hit harder than I expected.
I back off and raise the barrier again.

lines.zh: 外壳凹了一块，我记住了。
lines.en: A dent in my shell; noted.
My shell needs a few seconds to repair.
A joint is stiff; it won't matter.
You have nerve.
That energy isn't enough to power me.

lines.zh: 拿能量喂我？你真会开玩笑。
lines.en: Feeding me energy? You do have a sense of humor.
I reach out, and not because I'm hungry.
One isn't enough; bring a crate.

lines.zh: 检测到能量，我靠近了半步。
lines.en: Energy detected; I move half a step closer.

lines.zh: 机械不需要吃饭，但需要这个。
lines.en: Metal needn't eat, but it needs this.
You hold it up like feeding an animal.
Absorbing; efficiency is low.

lines.zh: 金属身体，够得着你指头。
lines.en: This metal body can reach your fingers.
I'm not grateful; I just don't waste.

lines.zh: 你撞上了合金，声音很闷。
lines.en: You struck the alloy with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你就退了三步。
lines.en: I didn't move, and you fell back three steps.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的金属外壳走。
lines.en: Don't walk so close to my metal hide.

lines.zh: 金属身体挪一步，地都在震。
lines.en: One step of this metal body shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 我的外壳比你想象的硬。
lines.en: My shell is harder than you think.
I noted the position of that contact.

lines.zh: 金属碰活肉，结果你知道。
lines.en: Metal against flesh; you know the result.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，风把你压弯。
lines.en: I pass over your head and the wind bends you.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的金属影子。
lines.en: You stepped on my metal shadow.
Crowd me again and I'll grab you.

lines.zh: 我们这一族靠机械自我复制。
lines.en: My kind replicate by machine.
I hand her a fragment of myself.
She will copy me into two.

lines.zh: 没有感情，只有制造流程。
lines.en: No feeling, only a manufacturing process.
Two metal bodies hover side by side.

lines.zh: 这是我最接近温柔的动作。
lines.en: This is the closest thing I have to tenderness.
Data passes back and forth between us.

lines.zh: 复制体醒了，和我一样冷。
lines.en: The copy wakes, as cold as I am.
We don't need names.

lines.zh: 多一个我，就多一份麻烦。
lines.en: One more of me means one more problem.
I lift it with one hand.

lines.zh: 这东西放进回路刚刚好。
lines.en: This fits the circuit perfectly.
A clean metallic ring — good material.
I flatten it and stow it in my cuff.
I look at it, then toss it away.

lines.zh: 这点重量，对我不算什么。
lines.en: This weight means nothing to me.
It grows hot in my palm.
I snap it and keep half.

lines.zh: 回收完成，效率百分之二。
lines.en: Salvage complete: two percent efficiency.

lines.zh: 我把它扔给你，你接不接得住？
lines.en: I toss it your way — can you catch?

lines.zh: 锁定。你已经没有退路了。
lines.en: Locked. You have no line of retreat.

lines.zh: 气读数上升，我在等你出手。
lines.en: Your reading is climbing; I'm waiting for the first move.
I've raised my barrier first.

lines.zh: 你的坐标已进入近距离区间。
lines.en: Your coordinates have entered close range.

lines.zh: 目标确认，开始计算击杀。
lines.en: Target confirmed; calculating the kill.

lines.zh: 我看你抬手，就知道你要攻。
lines.en: You raised your hand, so I know you'll attack.
This distance will do.
I press forward half a block.

lines.zh: 你的躲闪范围已经封闭。
lines.en: Your dodge radius is closed.
You first; everything else later.
The thrusters on my back are open.
Let's see what you're worth.

lines.zh: 这一战不需要第二个人。
lines.en: This fight needs no second opponent.
I'm charging; don't interrupt.

lines.zh: 手已经抬起来了，来不及了。
lines.en: My hand is already up; too late.
The moment your breath stops, I move.

lines.zh: 残影留在原地，我在你背后。
lines.en: An afterimage stays put; I'm behind you.
I've swapped position with the afterimage fist.

lines.zh: 小气弹先试探，破你的防。
lines.en: Small ki blasts first, to test your guard.

lines.zh: 你躲得开第一轮，第二轮呢？
lines.en: You dodged the first volley; what about the second?
I rise and press down from above.
The ground is covered in my shadows.
My prediction is half a beat ahead of you.
The Supernova forms in my hand.
I keep my distance; ranged work is cheaper.
Your ki blast hit nothing.

lines.zh: 一步一换位，你看不清我。
lines.en: A new position every step; you can't follow.

lines.zh: 这一招需要时间，你正好给我。
lines.en: This move needs time, and you're providing it.
Your left shoulder rides too high.
No rush to kill; I'll wear you down.
You give a block and I take two.
The light gathers in my hand very quietly.

lines.zh: 我看你的脚，那里不会骗人。
lines.en: I watch your feet; they never lie.

lines.zh: 锁定不解除，直到你倒下。
lines.en: The lock holds until you fall.

lines.zh: 蓄气突击，撞上你的胸口。
lines.en: A charged rush slams into your chest.

lines.zh: 空中连击，三下都落在同一处。
lines.en: Aerial combo; all three land in the same spot.

lines.zh: 我的拳砸下去，地面凹了。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the ground caves.
A ki laser lances from my palm.

lines.zh: 气功屏障挡开你的反击。
lines.en: My ki barrier turns your counter aside.
I pin you to the ground.
The knee arrives first, the head after.
One punch; you snap three trees.
I used half my strength for that.
I don't follow; I stand and watch you rise.

lines.zh: 金属摩擦的声音很刺耳。
lines.en: The sound of metal on metal is harsh.

lines.zh: 我在半空收住，落在你侧后。
lines.en: I stop midair and land at your flank.
From this angle your armor won't help.
One blow to settle it; I don't like dragging.
My fingers dig into your shoulder.
I flick my hand and blood falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从高空降下来，没激起尘。
lines.en: I descend from high up without raising dust.
Metal Cooler has arrived.

lines.zh: 这颗星球的空气有铁味。
lines.en: The air of this planet tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我的身体是新的，比旧的更好。
lines.en: This body is new, and better than the old.

lines.zh: 我扫过这片地形，全是杂物。
lines.en: I sweep the terrain; it's all clutter.

lines.zh: 任务目标，就在这几格里。
lines.en: The objective lies within these few blocks.
Thrusters off, I hold position.
My shadow lands before I do.
I tilt my head and work the neck joint.
Last time I died here.
I won't make that mistake again.
I land and the ground dents.
All life is consumable.
I step out of the pod, cold.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在结构里回荡。
lines.en: My footsteps echo through the structure.
Are you ready to receive me?

lines.zh: 金属的躯体，气功激光不冷却。
lines.en: A metal body — my ki lasers never cool.
A scrape of metal, and I'm here.

lines.zh: 火焰烧得我外壳发红，热能超标。
lines.en: Flame heats my shell red; thermal load exceeded.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，落地时裂了肩甲。
lines.en: I fall from high up and my shoulder plate splits on impact.

lines.zh: 液体进到接缝里，动作变慢。
lines.en: Liquid seeps into my seams and my motion slows.
The blast tears my side plate open.

lines.zh: 弹丸嵌在我的胸口，还在震。
lines.en: The shot is lodged in my chest, still vibrating.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕过装甲，直钻内部。
lines.en: That force bypasses my armor and drills inside.

lines.zh: 能量见底，我的视野暗了一块。
lines.en: Energy low; a patch of my vision goes dark.

lines.zh: 电流灌满回路，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Current floods my circuits and I lock up for an instant.

lines.zh: 坐标崩了，我在没有方向的地方坠落。
lines.en: Coordinates collapse; I fall with no direction.
